concept: A private motorsport club; track days and membership.

shots.title: Hero, studio
shots.camera: Low three-quarter front, 50mm, camera at headlight height
shots.prompt: Studio automotive photograph of a track car of original design with racing numbers and no sponsor logos, finished in a signal-orange livery with white stripes, three-quarter front view in a vast dark studio. One long overhead softbox draws a continuous highlight along the bonnet, shoulder line and roof; polished dark concrete floor with a soft reflection under the car; negative space on the left for a headline. Original vehicle design, unbadged. Overall look: motorsport photography, panning blur, bright; colour palette of asphalt grey, signal orange, white, black. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks.
